gloss: senshō (lucky-morning day); winning the first game

definitions.gloss: senshō: the day of the rokuyō cycle when mornings are lucky
definitions.explanation: One of the six days of the traditional rokuyō calendar cycle. Mornings are considered lucky and afternoons unlucky, so things are best done early. Printed on many Japanese calendars.

definitions.gloss: winning the first game (of a series)
definitions.explanation: In sports, winning the first game or match of a series, which gives a team the lead.

examples.japanese: ⟦{明日|あした}→明日：00501_ashita⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{先勝|せんしょう}だ。
{先勝|せんしょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{午前中|ごぜんちゅう}→午前中：11495_gozenchuu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧。
examples.english: On a senshō day, the morning is the lucky time.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖母|そぼ}→祖母：00813_sobo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{先勝|せんしょう}だ⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{契約|けいやく}→契約：02698_keiyaku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{午前中|ごぜんちゅう}→午前中：11495_gozenchuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{済|す}ませ→済む：01950_sumu⟧⟦なさい→なさる：01307_nasaru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}った→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: My grandmother said that since it was a senshō day, I should sign the contract in the morning.

examples.japanese: ⟦ホーム→ホーム：00113_hoomu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{先勝|せんしょう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: To take the opening game at home.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦シリーズ→シリーズ：10942_shiriizu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{先勝|せんしょう}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦チーム→チーム：03858_chiimu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{優勝|ゆうしょう}する→優勝する：25496_yuushousuru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: In the Japan Series, the team that wins the first game often goes on to win the title.

notes:
In sense 1 the day is also read さきがち or せんかち; せんしょう is the commonest reading.
